description.value: Brightside Eggs is a third-generation family farm in Chilliwack producing certified-organic, cage-free, free-range eggs audited annually by ECO-CERT Canada. The farm operates 'The Egg Shack,' a self-serve on-site vending machine where visitors can purchase hand-sorted, ungraded eggs in recyclable cartons at any time without needing cash. A stop here offers touring cyclists a direct connection to Fraser Valley agricultural heritage and a genuinely local food purchase.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an operating certified-organic egg farm at 6899 Evans Rd, Chilliwack, matching the OSM address. The farm sells eggs through an on-site vending machine ('The Egg Shack') that accepts tap-capable credit/debit and mobile wallet but no cash — confirming vending machine and a basic grocery item (eggs). No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: No phone number available in OSM tags or on the website.
Operating hours are not published on the website — visitors are directed to Instagram or Google for current hours, which reduces reliability for trip planning.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, operating farm-direct food stop with a self-serve vending machine selling certified organic eggs — a genuinely unique and local purchase point for touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack's agricultural corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email contact listed on website: info@brightsideeggs.ca. OSM tag organic=only is consistent with website's ECO-CERT Canada certification claim.

Vending machines.detail: On-farm egg vending machine ('The Egg Shack') at 6899 Evans Rd; accepts tap-capable credit/debit and mobile wallet — no cash accepted
